verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Here's my heart Lord, here's my heart Lord
Here's my heart Lord, speak what is true

verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
I am found, I am Yours, I am loved, I'm made pure
I have life, I can breathe, I am healed, I am free

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
'Cause You are strong, You are sure
You are life, You endure
You are good, always true, You are light
Breaking through

verse.name: c2
verse.lines:
Here's my life Lord, here's my life Lord
Here's my life Lord, speak what is true
Speak what is true

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
Cause You are more than enough
You are here, You are love
You are hope, You are grace, You're all I have
You're everything
